editorial_zh: 本期窗口为 2026-10-20 至 2026-11-01：自上次成功的 2026-10-23 向前重叠三天，并补上 10-26 那次因执行环境故障停摆的更新；共返回 52 条候选，Europe PMC 两路检索因上限被截断（38 与 51 条命中各取 30），arXiv 本窗口 0 命中，来源均未报错。绝大多数候选是衰老、蛋白修饰与药理学等普通生物学综述，只有 8 篇左右与 AIVM 直接相关。本期最值得注意的是两篇工作把“模型有没有被独立数据验证”摆到台面上：粪肠球菌 TX0016 的手工重建模型用 Biolog 表型芯片和氨基酸缺失实验逐项给出混淆矩阵，诚实报告基因必需性 MCC 仅 0.27，比一味展示高准确率有用得多；鱼类血管出芽的单细胞代谢建模则用四道审计说明，在常见设置下 19.5% 的反应可携带热力学不可行的环路通量，吞下这些审计就足以推翻一个常规筛选得到的候选靶点。另有两篇只读到摘要、未取到全文：LGG 营养控制重建，以及 ESM-2 加随机森林的两段式酶功能预测。本周仍无提供独立同位素通量数据的新论文。
editorial_en: This issue covers 2026-10-20 to 2026-11-01: it overlaps three days before the last successful run on 2026-10-23 and also covers the 2026-10-26 update that stalled on an execution-environment failure. Retrieval returned 52 candidates. Two Europe PMC queries were truncated at the cap (38 and 51 hits, 30 taken each) and arXiv returned 0 hits in this window; no source reported an error. Most candidates are ordinary biology reviews on ageing, protein modification or pharmacology, and only about eight are directly relevant to AIVM. The standout contributions bring independent validation of a model to the foreground. A manually curated genome-scale model of Enterococcus faecium TX0016 reports confusion matrices against Biolog phenotype microarrays and amino-acid dropout experiments and honestly records a gene-essentiality MCC of only 0.27, which is far more useful than showcasing high accuracy. A single-cell metabolic modelling study of zebrafish vascular sprouting uses four audits to show that, under common settings, 19.5% of reactions can carry thermodynamically infeasible loop flux, enough to overturn a candidate target from a conventional screen. Two further papers were read only as abstracts because full text was unavailable: a nutrient-controlled reconstruction of LGG and a two-stage ESM-2 plus random-forest enzyme function predictor. No new paper this week provides independent isotope-tracing flux validation.

snapshots.title: An experimentally validated manually curated genome-scale metabolic model of Enterococcus faecium TX0016 reproduces high-throughput phenotyping data
snapshots.authors: Rasmi D, Krishnan K, Hashem Y, Palsson B, Kashef M, Monk J, Aziz R.
snapshots.summary_zh: 作者基于心内膜炎患者分离株 TX0016 的手工重建得到 iDR478，用 COBRApy 0.25 与 glpk 做 FBA，依 BiGG 与粪肠球菌模板模型设定可逆性边界并用间隙填充补全网络，再进行表型验证。以 0.078 h⁻¹ 生长阈值判定，模型对 Biolog 判定可利用的 46 种碳源预测出 40 种，准确率 86.9%，其中 6 种为假阴性；氨基酸缺失实验的必需性判定与实验完全一致；但基因必需性只有 MCC 0.27、灵敏度 0.39，作者归因于表达调控与表型端点差异。
snapshots.why_read: 这是少见的把手工重建、高通量表型验证和诚实错误分解写在一起的案例。对判断一个同物种模型能否用于营养控制、培养基设计与基因必需性筛选，它给出了可比较的基准线，也明确示范了不同验证端点之间的差距如何改变结论。
snapshots.limitation: 验证集中在单一菌株与批量表型芯片，未使用同位素示踪或实测通量；基因必需性 MCC 0.27 意味着直接用该模型做必需基因或药物靶点筛选会产生大量假阳性和假阴性，报告中未给出在给定假阳性率下可容许的使用边界。
snapshots.new_question: 在模型表型验证与基因必需性验证给出截然不同结论时，应当如何定义模型可用范围并据此设计培养基与筛选，而不是只报告一个总体准确率？
snapshots.summary_en: The authors manually curated iDR478 for endocarditis isolate TX0016, ran FBA with COBRApy 0.25 and glpk, set reversibility bounds from BiGG and the E. faecalis template model, filled network gaps, and then validated phenotypes. Using a 0.078 per hour growth threshold, the model predicted growth on 40 of the 46 Biolog substrates scored as utilised, an accuracy of 86.9%, with six false negatives. Essentiality predictions for amino-acid dropout experiments agreed fully with the experiments, whereas gene essentiality reached only an MCC of 0.27 and sensitivity 0.39, which the authors attribute to transcriptional regulation and differing phenotype endpoints.
snapshots.why_read_en: It is a rare case that puts manual curation, high-throughput phenotype validation and an honest error breakdown in one paper. It supplies a comparable baseline for deciding whether a same-species model supports nutrient control, medium design and gene-essentiality screening, and shows concretely how different validation endpoints change conclusions.
snapshots.limitation_en: Validation rests on a single strain and bulk phenotype microarrays without isotope tracing or measured fluxes. A gene-essentiality MCC of 0.27 implies that using this model directly for essential-gene or drug-target screening will produce many false positives and negatives, and the paper does not state the operating range that is acceptable at a given false-positive rate.
snapshots.method_en: Manually curated GEM with FBA, gap filling and Biolog / auxotrophy validation

snapshots.title: FluxSprout: Single-cell metabolic modeling of vascular sprouting in zebrafish
snapshots.summary_zh: 预印本提出 FluxSprout 框架，把 10,090 个质控后的单细胞转录组数据与 Zebrafish-GEM 结合，为 14 种内皮与造血状态重建网络集合，并设四道审计：化学计量审计、环路审计、细胞周期对照测试与集合特异性筛选。结果指出四个被误注为氧化磷酸化的焦磷酸酶反应，只要交换通量不受限就会造成虚假通路必需性；19.5% 的反应可携带热力学不可行环路通量，而常规筛选的全部候选都在其中；在 825 个基因与四种网络提取设置下，没有一个候选被多于一个设置同时选中。以上内容依据摘要。
snapshots.why_read: 它把网络注释不确定性、热力学可行性和集合特异性当作与通量预测同等重要的评价对象，并用具体数字说明常规单细胞代谢筛选有多容易被重建假象带走。对设计单细胞代谢推断的评价协议、以及判断某个候选靶点是否稳健，是可直接套用的检查清单。
snapshots.limitation: 作者自认数据来自单一 pooled clutch 且需实验验证；更关键的是目前只读到摘要，四道审计的具体实现、细胞周期对照如何定义、以及转录组如何进入通量约束均未核实，无法判断这些折扣比例在其他组织或模型上是否同样成立。
snapshots.new_question: 如果大多数单细胞代谢靶点在合理的网络集合与通量约束下都不稳健，那么单细胞代谢推断应当以何种可检验的信息结构输出，才能让下游实验选择有确定的成功概率？
snapshots.summary_en: The preprint introduces FluxSprout, a framework that combines 10,090 quality-controlled single-cell transcriptomes with Zebrafish-GEM to reconstruct network ensembles for 14 endothelial and haemogenic states, guarded by four audits: stoichiometric, loop, cell-cycle-controlled testing and ensemble specificity screening. It reports four inorganic pyrophosphatase reactions misannotated as oxidative phosphorylation that create apparent pathway essentiality only when exchange fluxes are unbounded; 19.5% of reactions could carry thermodynamically infeasible loop flux, including every candidate of a conventional screen; and across 825 genes and four network-extraction settings, no candidate was called by more than one setting. These statements are based on the abstract only.
snapshots.why_read_en: It treats network annotation uncertainty, thermodynamic feasibility and ensemble specificity as evaluation targets on par with flux prediction, and quantifies how easily a conventional single-cell metabolic screen is driven by reconstruction artefacts. It is a directly reusable checklist for designing evaluation protocols for single-cell metabolic inference and for judging candidate robustness.
snapshots.limitation_en: The authors state the data come from a single pooled clutch and require experimental validation. More importantly, only the abstract was read, so the exact implementation of the four audits, the definition of the cell-cycle control and how transcriptomes enter flux constraints were not verified, leaving open whether these discount factors hold for other tissues or models.
snapshots.method_en: scRNA-seq-informed ensemble GEM modelling with four audit safeguards

snapshots.title: A Two-Stage ESM-Based Machine Learning Pipeline for Robust Hierarchically Evaluated Enzyme Function Prediction.
snapshots.summary_zh: 作者构建 ESM-ECForest 两段式流程：先用 ESM-2 蛋白语言模型产生固定长度嵌入，再用随机森林在 UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot 2026_01 构建的数据上先区分酶与非酶，随后对判定为酶的蛋白做 EC 层次多标签预测。在两万五千余条序列的外部基准上，加权 F1 从 EC 一级 0.94 降至四级 0.90；消融显示若用真实酶状态替代预测门控，四级加权 F1 从 0.902 升到 0.921，去掉门控则降至 0.863，说明误差主要来自门控而非 EC 分类本身。
snapshots.why_read: 酶注释是 GEM 反应与基因映射的上游入口，错误注释会直接变成网络里的假反应。这篇把评分按 EC 层级拆开，并明确误差来自门控而不是分类，对决定是否值得把语言模型注释接进重建流程、以及在哪一层补人工核查，有直接的判断价值。
snapshots.limitation: 只用 UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot 构建训练与验证集，评估被限制在训练中出现的分类与 EC 标签空间；未报告在未参与训练的微生物基因组或宏基因组上的表现，也未给出注释错误传播到 GEM 的定量影响。
snapshots.new_question: 当酶注释的误差主要由门控这一上游二分类决定时，重建流程应当如何在门控置信度与水解平衡之间分配人工核查预算？
snapshots.summary_en: ESM-ECForest is a two-stage pipeline that first converts proteins into fixed-length embeddings with the ESM-2 protein language model, then uses random forests trained on UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot 2026_01 to separate enzymes from non-enzymes and finally assign EC numbers hierarchically to predicted enzymes. On an external benchmark of 25,778 sequences, weighted F1 fell from 0.94 at EC level 1 to 0.90 at level 4. Ablations show that replacing the predicted gate with true enzyme status raises level-4 weighted F1 from 0.902 to 0.921, while removing the gate drops it to 0.863, indicating that gate errors, not EC assignment, dominate.
snapshots.why_read_en: Enzyme annotation is the upstream entry into GEM reaction and gene mapping, so misannotation becomes spurious network reactions. Splitting scores by EC level and attributing error to the gate rather than to EC assignment directly informs whether language-model annotation is worth wiring into reconstruction and at which level manual review is needed.
snapshots.limitation_en: Training and validation used only UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot, so evaluation is confined to the taxonomic and EC-label space represented during training. Performance on unrepresented microbial genomes or metagenomes is not reported, and the downstream effect of annotation errors on a GEM is not quantified.
snapshots.method_en: Two-stage ESM-2 embeddings plus random forest EC classification

snapshots.title: Nutrient control enables metabolic reconstruction of Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG and analysis of secretions.
snapshots.authors: Richmond GR, Cunha E, Kelly L, Dias Ó, Chang RL.
snapshots.summary_zh: 作者为益生菌鼠李糖乳杆菌 GG（LGG）给出首个手工整理基因组尺度代谢模型，做法是联合多个自动草稿模型、已发表研究文献与高通量确定成分培养基实验完成重建与验证。结果包含一系列化学确定成分培养基、大量单组分营养缺失生长数据，以及关于分泌产物、乳酸与吲哚-3-甲醛的计算与体外对照，并据此刻画 LGG 的最小营养需求。此条依据摘要，因该刊非开放获取且无 PMCID，未取得全文。
snapshots.why_read: 营养需求数据是约束可用性的直接来源。与只做网络拓扑重建的草稿模型相比，这类以营养缺失实验闭环的重建方式，是判断模型能否可信地用于培养基设计与肠道环境模拟的关键依据。
snapshots.limitation: 未取得全文，实验重复数、具体生长判定阈值、模型预测与体外实验结果的一致性程度均无法核实；因此在确认这些数字之前，不应把该模型当作已验证的代谢模拟工具引用。
snapshots.new_question: 在多源草稿模型、文献与缺失实验共同作为证据时，应当如何给每条反应分配并累计置信度，才能使重建过程可审计？
snapshots.summary_en: The authors present the first curated genome-scale model for the probiotic Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG, reconstructed and validated by combining several automatically generated drafts, published studies and high-throughput defined-medium experiments. The results include a set of chemically defined media, extensive single-component nutrient dropout growth data, in silico plus in vitro comparisons of secretion products, lactate and indole-3-carboxaldehyde, and an in silico characterisation of LGG nutrient requirements. This entry rests on the abstract because the article is not open access and has no PMCID, so full text was not obtained.
snapshots.why_read_en: Nutrient requirement data are a direct source of usable constraints. Compared with draft models built on topology alone, this phenotype-closed reconstruction is the key evidence for judging whether a model can be trusted for medium design and gut-environment simulation.
snapshots.limitation_en: Full text was not obtained, so replicate counts, the specific growth-call thresholds and the agreement between model predictions and in vitro results cannot be verified. Until those numbers are checked the model should not be cited as an experimentally validated simulation tool.
snapshots.method_en: Literature and defined-media driven manual reconstruction of an LGG GEM
